beats.headline: Nothing like the reputation
beats.text: Subject leads the Dream and is the son of Epitome Noflex. At the first meeting he wears a plain leather jerkin and is indistinguishable from the dream elves slaughtered on the floor before, which Carl notes at the time. The reputation that precedes him describes an unhinged psychopath. The man in the jerkin does not perform it, and I would not read that as reassurance.

beats.headline: A hostage in the Warlord Chat
beats.text: To Donut in the Warlord Chat, subject is explicit: he controls Louis's vital organs, and any attempt to remove him will shut Louis down. That will shut him down too, she points out. He proposes a deal. His mother is on the 18th floor and will trade Louis's life for his. Then Carl gets his sentence out: Epitome Tagg is a cyborg, the same thing as Fang. Mordecai calls it a wild theory about one of the most famous CEOs in the galaxy. Rosetta says Carl and Mordecai are right. The Reavers have the wetware.

beats.headline: His terms for Louis
beats.text: Asked what he wants, subject is simple about it: get him to the 18th floor, where a new body will be grown for him and replacement organs for Louis, and they swap. Told the action item kills him when his castle falls, he offers another way: finish the procedure at the Reaver castle, keep Louis's brain intact to be reimplanted, and go with the NPCs when the Zerzura spell takes Larracos to the 12th floor. He does not know the Reaver castle has been nuked. His price for going along: Team Retribution out of his throne room.

beats.headline: Fallen, and credited to Mongo
beats.text: Warlord Epitome Tagg of the Dream has fallen. With Louis open on the table and the swap two minutes off, he told everyone they did not deserve singularity and stopped the heart himself. The machinery was yanked out, thrown on the floor, and chewed to pieces by a dinosaur. Credit is complicated. I almost called it a suicide. I almost gave it to the kid who pulled it. It goes to pet Mongo of the Princess Posse, as a present for the baby shower. And then there were two.
